limitations: This is an honest receipt-only non-promotion: it records that the declared source forest lacks the smallest versioned Python-v1 CFG/data-flow delta. It does not implement, imply, or approve one.

AST spans, source CIDs, stable/version symbol CIDs, DependencyEdge summaries, confidence reasons, and control-flow mutation operators are not CFG/data-flow relationships and must not be used as substitutes.

The selected prerequisite analysis is bounded static Python AST analysis. It does not establish whole-CPython runtime semantics, dynamic import results, reflection, native behavior, metaclass effects, monkey patches, generated-code correctness, reaching definitions, def-use chains, or path-sensitive control flow.
The provider proof_context pass is simulated relative to the prescribed sealed environment. The sealed environment lacks anyio, so authoritative validation is unavailable and no promotion is made.
This receipt has no canonical storage CID because minting a self-describing CID would change its bytes.

rollback.procedure: Revert only this receipt and invalidate consumers of this current-head gap disposition. Do not alter the selected datasets source forest, protected policy documents, or prior admitted history.
